page.overview:
Who is Elephant?

The Elephant is an animal that was first introduced in 2003.

The elephant first appeared as part of the LEGO Adventurers Orient Expedition theme. It is available in two colors: dark grey and grey. They appear in the 2003 sets 7414 Elephant Caravan and 7418 Scorpion Palace. They use the Animal Building System body and legs pieces. This same design of elephant appears in various video games and can be ridden in LEGO Indiana Jones: The Original Adventures, LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars, and LEGO Batman: The Videogame.

In 2020, a more cartoony version of the animal was released as part of the Friends theme, available in both adult and baby variants.

In 2021, a more tradition redesign of the animal was released as part of the City theme, available in both adult and baby variants.
